chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Aban from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Pray the obligatory and voluntary prayers with your family in Ramadan, for indeed I do so."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on praying with family during Ramadan according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) emphasizes the virtue of congregational prayer within the domestic sphere during Ramadan, specifically encouraging the performance of both obligatory and voluntary prayers with one's family. By citing his own practice ('for I do it'), he establishes a normative model for integrating spiritual discipline with family life, highlighting that the home can serve as a secondary mosque for strengthening communal bonds during the holy month.
